# Module notes

<!-- provenance -->
> **AI-written interpretation** of the code at commit `1a80fc8`, based on the extracted facts (`integrations.md`, `change-impact.md`, `architecture.md`, `data-model.md`, `graph.json`) and sampled source. Verify details against the code.


One sentence on what each busy folder, and each file to be careful with, is for. Written from names only (paths, function and class names), not from reading the code.

## Folders

- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/app`: Manages documents, contexts, commands, and fonts for the app.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor`: Contains the main entry point for editor features.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/command`: Handles command operations and management within the editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/global`: Defines global functions and UI themes for the editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/input/ui`: Manages UI interactions and input handling for the editor.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/editor/view`: Controls entity visibility and selection in the editor view.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/i18n`: Handles internationalization and localization messages.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/service`: Provides services for entity and layer management.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/ui`: Manages various UI components like dialogs and panels.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/util`: Offers utility functions for drawing and measurement operations.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/view`: Manages view-related functionalities like layouts and overlays.
- `packages/vite-config`: Defines Vite configuration and plugin rollup outputs.

## Files to be careful with

- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/ui/AcUiFullscreenPanel.ts`: Handles fullscreen panel operations within the UI.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/command/draw/AcApSplineCmd.ts`: Executes and manages spline command operations.
- `packages/cad-simple-viewer/src/view/AcTrLayout.ts`: Handles layout and entity preview operations.
- `packages/cad-svg-plugin/src/AcSvgEntity.ts`: Manages SVG entity creation and manipulation.
- `packages/pdf-renderer/src/renderer/AcPdfEntity.ts`: Handles PDF entity rendering and operations.
